purpose: Document structures and examples for review. This file is documentation, not a database import file or an executable validation schema.

included: Ownership fields for future multi-user support

proposedConventions.documentIds: Use a document-type prefix followed by a unique identifier. Example IDs below are illustrative.
proposedConventions.ownership: Every account, category and transaction has an ownerId. user:demo is a placeholder, not an implemented user account.
proposedConventions.documentType: The type field identifies account, category or transaction.
proposedConventions.transactionDirection: The direction field identifies income or expense.
proposedConventions.money: Store amounts as positive integers in the currency's minor unit. For EUR, 2500 means EUR 25.00.
proposedConventions.currency: For the MVP, use EUR only. Store currency on accounts and transactions to make the assumption explicit.
proposedConventions.transactionDate: Use YYYY-MM-DD for the business date of a transaction.
proposedConventions.timestamps: Use UTC timestamps such as 2026-10-15T16:00:00Z for createdAt and updatedAt.
proposedConventions.optionalFields: Optional fields may be omitted. Examples include them where useful.
proposedConventions.revisions: Do not invent _rev values for new documents. CouchDB supplies revision information; updates must use the current revision.
proposedConventions.deletion: Propose archiving accounts and categories instead of deleting those referenced by transactions.
proposedConventions.balances: Do not store a mutable current balance. Calculate it from openingBalanceMinor plus income minus expenses for each account.

account.description: A cash or bank account belonging to one owner.

requiredFields.name: string: non-empty display name
requiredFields.currency: string: EUR for the proposed MVP
requiredFields.openingBalanceMinor: integer: initial balance in cents; may be zero or negative
requiredFields.isArchived: boolean: whether the account is unavailable for new transactions

examples.name: Cash
examples.description: Cash available when starting to use the application.

category.description: An income or expense category belonging to one owner.

requiredFields.name: string: non-empty display name
requiredFields.isArchived: boolean: whether the category is unavailable for new transactions

transaction.description: One income or expense operation linked to an account and a category.

requiredFields.amountMinor: integer: strictly positive amount in cents
requiredFields.currency: string: must match the referenced account currency
requiredFields.date: string: valid transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD format
requiredFields.accountId: string: reference to an account document
requiredFields.categoryId: string: reference to a category document

relationships.rule: The account must exist and have the same ownerId as the transaction.
The category must exist and have the same ownerId and direction as the transaction.
Ownership is modelled now; authentication and access control will be implemented separately.

proposedValidationRules: Reject unknown document types and transaction directions.
Require non-empty names for accounts and categories.
Require amountMinor to be a positive integer.
Require openingBalanceMinor to be an integer.
Require valid dates and UTC timestamps.
Require transaction currency to match account currency.
Require linked documents to belong to the same owner.
Require transaction direction to match category direction.
Do not allow new transactions to reference archived accounts or categories.
Do not change the owner of an existing document.
Do not change an account currency or category direction after transactions reference it.
Keep archived accounts and categories available when displaying historical transactions.
Set ownership from the authenticated identity once authentication is implemented; do not trust a client-supplied ownerId.
reviewPoints: Confirm the proposed single-currency EUR scope.
Confirm that every transaction requires a category.
Confirm how opening balances should behave if backdated transactions are added.
Confirm whether per-user ownership is sufficient initially or whether organisation/workspace ownership is needed.
Confirm archiving behaviour and transaction editing/deletion policy.
